text:
anya: Post-lock canary handoff — dropping an async standup here since most folks are in different timezones. Quick status: rolled cutover at 02:15 UTC, started canary at 2% traffic. please report what you did / blockers / plans for today.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout: model-v2 -> 2% (route slice alpha), started 1719008700 :gear:

kai: what I did: verified golden traces for v2, ran perf smoke (latency p50 ~18ms, p95 ~46ms). noticed 1 pod had CPU spikes after ~2000 reqs.
blockers: pod 3 still OOM-killed once, logs show spike from batched requests + quant decode.
today: isolating batch config for that node, will cap batch size to 8 and redeploy small patch.

miguel: what I did: looked at canary logs, found transient KV cache warmup causing 200ms tail for cold connections. added cache priming task for slices.
blockers: need approval to increase cache memory on dedicated slice (will affect quotas).
today: pinging infra for quota change, prepping rollout runbook update.

sre-liz: what I did: checked alerts, saw 2x increase in 5xxs during 02:25-02:28 window, then dropped after restart of pod 3. Investigating cause.
blockers: none blocking rollout now but want postmortem notes saved in #incidents if we see recurrence.
today: will add a short watchlist for next 2 hours and set stricter backoff on client retries to avoid thundering herd.

anya: update — bumped canary to 5% at 02:40 UTC after restart and patch, metrics look stable. p95 now 50ms, errors down to baseline. rolling ramp plan: 5% -> 15% in 30m if no regressions.

samir: quick code review ping — tiny change to batching config in infra repo: https://git.company/infra/commit/9f4b2c. Please LGTM if safe.

kai: LGTM for patch, only concern is memory footprint. I tested on local emu with batch=8, peak mem +6% on that model but under OOM threshold.

miguel: @anya can we add a feature-flag to toggle priming per-slice? prefer toggling over quota changes if infra is slow.

anya: good call. added ff: `slice_cache_priming` on the service flags dashboard. Enabling for alpha slice now.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout: model-v2 -> 15% at 1719010954 :rocket:

sre-liz: heads-up: I'm going to keep alerts noise-reduced but will escalate if error rate >1% sustained for 5m.

anya: blockers summary from thread: pod OOM on one node (patched), cache memory quota request pending. Actions: kai patch -> decluster batch size, miguel priming ff, samir got CR approved. Ramp continues to 15%. If anyone sees regression, call pager and mark incident channel.

kai: small note — I left a monitoring dashboard snapshot in the runbook under "canary-checks". link: https://dash.company/canary/1719007654

miguel: done with infra ping, they approved temp quota bump for alpha slice until next cycle. will rollback quota after stability window.

anya: thanks all. I'll toggle to a 30m watch and update once we hit 100% (or earlier if problems). :white_check_mark:
